Name: (AT) Giant Flower Varity
Author: FryoKnight
Description:
You see, I absolutely love [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6653?tab=files]Neo's Giant Flowers[/url]. But I have always had an issue that alot of the Multicolor flowers were always a single color. There was a supplementary pack added later, with assets done by Kaya, but it still only let you have a single color (but now of your choice).

Well, no longer! I now introduce my Giant Flower Variants for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6653?tab=files]Neo's Giant Flowers[/url]! Now you can experience the joy of having a colorful, giant flower garden!


[b][color=#ffd966][size=4]How to Use:[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5263]More Giant Crops[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6653?tab=files]Neo's Giant Flowers[/url] as instructed on their respective pages.
[*]Throw this mod in your Mods folder afterwards
[*]Enjoy having a colorful array of Giant Flowers!
[/list]

[color=#ff0000][b][size=4]Issues:[/size][/b]
[/color][list]
[*]Giant Flowers still only drop the "base" color of flower. I don't think there is anything I can do about that at this time.
[*]You have to grow the Giant Flowers naturally. Sadly the [i]Spray Can[/i] or [i]Paint Bucket[/i] from AT do not work on Giant Crops, including these ones.
[/list]


[color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Recommended mods:[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#efefef][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11620]Giant Crop Fertilizer[/url]﻿ - Adds in a late-game Fertilizer that makes Giant Crops nearly guaranteed.[/size][/color]
[*][color=#efefef][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10996]Better Beehouses[/url] - Allows for Giant Flower Crops to be used by Beehouses to make honey[/size][/color]
[*][color=#efefef][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13052]Tap Giant Crops[/url] - Allows you to tap Giant Flowers for their Honey[/size][/color]
[/list][size=2][color=#efefef][b] ﻿• [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15055]Wickedy's Floral Essences[/url][b] - [/b]If you have[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13052]Tap Giant Crops[/url]﻿﻿[/b], then tapped flowers make Essence instead. Otherwise, you can use the extra flowers from the [/color]Giants to make more essences.
﻿[b]• [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5767]Flower Meads[/url][b] [/b]- Allows you to use the Honey from[b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13052]Tap Giant Crops[/url] to make unique meads instead of the generic one.[/size]
